$comment: Single source of truth for the SimWorld build tracker. Edit here; tools/blueprint regenerates the page. Item ids are stable keys — the tracker persists human ticks against them.

stack.host: Unity (renderer / UI host, added when there is something to render)
stack.core: src/SimWorld.Core — netstandard2.1 class library, no UnityEngine references, consumable as a local UPM package
stack.ci: GitHub Actions: dotnet build+test, blueprint build, markdown lint, link check, mermaid validation

phase.name: Systems as isolated modules
phase.summary: Port each RimWorld system as a separately tested module. No game loop, no renderer, no god layer yet.

launch.reason: Nothing to launch yet — phase 1 ships modules and tests only. A launch link appears here once a playable loop exists.

statusLegend.translated: Re-targeted for the god-game on top of the port

decisions.title: C# with Unity as the host
decisions.note: Core is an engine-free netstandard2.1 library (C# 9) so it builds and tests in CI without Unity; Unity references it as a local package.

decisions.title: Step 1 = isolated modules, no game loop
decisions.note: Each of the 17 researched systems becomes a module with its own tests before any loop or renderer.

decisions.title: Every citizen is a full agent
decisions.note: RimWorld-depth needs/mood/health/skills/jobs per person at civilization scale. Population target: as large as we can; the performance ceiling is a later bridge.

decisions.title: Large authored tech tree of societal evolution
decisions.note: Endless/procedural tech comes later; the research module's data model must not preclude it.

decisions.title: Director persona name
decisions.note: RimWorld's storyteller is translated into a chronicle-style narrator targeting YOUR civilization. Working candidates: Scribe, Historian, The Chronicle. Code module stays 'Director' until chosen.

decisions.title: Launch only when it makes sense
decisions.note: Tracker shows launch disabled with the reason until a playable loop exists.

decisions.title: Living tracker
decisions.note: Third tab in the Blueprint, generated from docs/status.json; repo-verified items are locked, remaining items are tick-able and persisted for everyone who opens the page.

decisions.title: Duplicate defName policy: later pack wins
decisions.note: Implementation choice mirroring mod load-order semantics (DefLoadOptions.DuplicatePolicy is switchable). Revisit when mod patching lands.

decisions.title: Auto-merge green PRs
decisions.note: PRs are merged as soon as CI is green; no manual merge step.

decisions.title: RimWorld's static Rand and Scribe stay static, but per thread
decisions.note: Ported call sites (Rand.Value, Scribe_Values.Look) keep their shape; state is [ThreadStatic] so tests and worker threads never share a sequence or a save session. Explicit RandomStream instances are the preferred form for new systems.

systems.translation: Unchanged. Defs, Comps and patching are engine-neutral; every later module is data-driven through this layer.

items.label: XML Defs loading: <Defs> root, Def type resolved from element name
Reflection field mapping: primitives, enums, nested objects, lists, dictionaries
Name / ParentName / Abstract inheritance with Inherit="False" and list append
Class="…" polymorphism and Type-valued fields (thingClass, compClass)
Deferred cross-references across files (fields, lists, dictionary values)
DefDatabase: typed registries incl. subclasses, duplicate policy, RimWorld-style static facade
DefOf static binding with DefAlias
Lifecycle order: PostLoad → cross-refs → ResolveReferences → ConfigErrors
CompProperties (data half of the Comp pattern) as a Class= list on ThingDef
StatDef / StatModifier with the element-name-as-stat idiom
IXmlCustomLoad hook, LoadAlias, Unsaved, IsNull
Culture-invariant ParseHelper incl. IntRange, FloatRange, CurvePoint/SimpleCurve
ThingComp runtime half (ThingWithComps.InitializeComps) — lands with the Things module
Mod content packs + PatchOperations (XPath patching)
Mod load order and dependency resolution

systems.translation: Proposed: planet generation at civilization scale — biomes, rivers and roads unchanged; many rival civilizations seeded instead of a handful of faction bases.

items.label: Icosphere tile grid (10·4ⁿ+2 tiles, 5/6 neighbours, lat/long) with coverage → subdivision
Seeded Perlin/ridged-multifractal noise → elevation (~32% land), hilliness, temperature by latitude and elevation, rainfall, swampiness
14 biome workers scoring tiles (ocean/lake by water-body size; tundra…rainforest; deserts)
Rivers flow downhill by flow thresholds; roads path between settlements over hilliness/biome cost
Minimal FactionDef/Faction + settlement placement (counts, min distance, biome weight); world save regenerates the grid from its seed
Initial faction relations and tech levels — lands with Factions
Translation: many rival civilizations at planet scale — population scaling and era seeding

systems.translation: Proposed: settlement-site maps, many per civilization, generated on demand from the world tile.

items.label: Terrain layer from tile biome + hilliness
Elevation → mountains, caves, water bodies; roads carried in
Scatterers: resource deposits, ruins, ancient structures, plant density
Cave systems and minable rock with mineral yield tables

systems.translation: Proposed: citizen generation. Birth and lineage drive most generation instead of 'wanderer joins'; backstories become life histories written by the sim.

items.label: Backstory pairs (childhood/adulthood): skill gains, disabled work tags, forced traits
Trait rolls by commonality with degrees, conflicts and required work tags
Skill levels from age-scaled curves plus backstory and trait gains; passion rolls
NameTriple/NameSingle from gendered name banks, unique across a population
Life stages and age tracker: biological/chronological ticks, body size, health scale and hunger factors per stage
Appearance: melanin and body type only — hair and palette land with the renderer
Translation: newborn generation and life events — birth and lineage as the main source of citizens is still open
Gear from faction tech level + PawnKindDef loadouts — lands with Items/Combat
Genes / xenotypes with inheritance (Biotech)

systems.translation: Unchanged. Tick engine, rare/long tick buckets, deterministic RNG streams, Scribe-style save/load. Bucket sizing scales with population.

items.label: TickManager: 60 ticks/s clock, TimeSpeed multipliers (1/3/6/15), pause/toggle, danger-forced normal speed
TickList buckets: normal / rare (250) / long (2000) with deferred register/deregister
Tick order: pre-tickers (world, map) → normal → rare → long → post-tickers; per-frame tick cap drops backlog
MurmurHash-based RandomStream per system + thread-safe static Rand facade (Range/Chance/Gaussian/MTB/PushState)
GenTicks / GenDate: 60,000-tick days, quadrums, years, longitude-local time, seasons by latitude
Scribe: IExposable save/load in three passes (LoadingVars → ResolvingCrossRefs → PostLoadInit)
Scribe_Values / Defs / Deep (polymorphic Class=) / References (forward + cyclic) / Collections (list, set, dictionary)
Autosave cadence — lands with the game loop
Streaming XmlWriter save path for very large worlds (current writer builds the document in memory)

systems.translation: Unchanged per citizen. Adds aggregate 'public mood' rollups so the god view can read a city without opening every person.

items.label: Pawn skeleton + RaceProperties: needs/story/mind trackers, hash-interval ticking, Scribe round-trip
NeedDef set: Food, Rest, Joy, Mood, Beauty, Comfort, Outdoors, RoomSize (intelligence-gated)
Decay rules: food 1.6/day slowing when hungry, rest fall/gain with fatigue factors, joy tolerance, seekers
Thoughts: timed memories (stack limit, renew-oldest) + situational workers, trait nullifying/required
Mood = 50% + grouped thought total with RimWorld's geometric stacking rule; seeker rates
MentalBreaker bands (0.35/0.20/0.05), 2000-tick grace, MTB rolls, weighted trait-filtered break table, state lifecycle + Catharsis
TraitDef/Trait/TraitSet with degrees, conflicts and exclusion tags
Core XML: Human/Husky races, needs, joy kinds, traits, thoughts, mental states and breaks
Social/opinion thoughts and social fights — lands with the Social module
Translation: population mood rollups for the god view
BodyDef part tree: tags, groups, height/depth, coverage → absolute coverage for hit selection (Human + quadruped)
Hediffs: severity-staged conditions with comps (immunizable, tend duration, severity/day, disappears, gets-permanent, infecter); injuries, missing parts, added parts
11 capacities from part efficiency (tag averages, limb products, cap mods); downed = pain shock / unconscious / no legs, dead = lethal capacity, core part, lethal severity or 150 total damage
DamageDef → worker → injury on a coverage-weighted part; solid parts crack, skin bruises; part destruction removes the subtree
Pain aggregate (Σ offsets × Π factors) → consciousness penalty, pain shock, Pain/Sick thoughts
Bleeding → blood loss (lethal at 1), natural healing 8/day (+4 lying, +22×quality tended), scars, infection rolls, tending priority
Immunity vs severity race per disease (flu survivable, plague/infection lethal untended); malnutrition from starvation; hediff hunger/rest factors
Core XML: 23 part tags, 13 groups, 38 part defs, 2 bodies, 11 capacities, 16 hediffs, 6 damages, health thoughts
Addictions and drug tolerance — lands with the Drugs/Items content
Surgery bills with skill-rolled outcomes — lands with Skills & Work

systems.translation: Proposed: skills unchanged; work priorities set by civ policy and roles (guilds, castes, laws) rather than a per-person grid.

items.label: SkillDef/SkillRecord/Pawn_SkillTracker: levels 0–20, per-pawn records in listOrder, daily xpSinceMidnight reset
XP curve 1000→30000, passion 0.35/1/1.5, 4000 xp/day saturation, level up/down
Unused-skill decay: levels 10+ lose 0.1–8.0 XP per 200-tick interval; below 10 never decays
Work tags from traits disable skills and work types; backstory hook
Pawn_WorkSettings: priority grid per work type, 0–4, useWorkPriorities on/off collapse, disabled types forced to 0
WorkGiverDef ordering: emergency first, priority → naturalPriority → priorityInType; scanning/jobs land with system 9
Core XML: 12 SkillDefs, 20 WorkTypeDefs, 27 WorkGiverDefs, Pyromaniac disables Firefighting
Skill-driven stats (WorkSpeedGlobal, MedicalTendQuality…) — lands with the Stats module
Backstory-disabled work — lands with Pawn Generation
Translation: policy/role-driven priorities at civ scale

systems.translation: Proposed: think tree and jobs unchanged; the god issues edicts and goals that enter the tree above routine work instead of draft orders. Pathfinding must be shared (hierarchical / flow fields) to survive full-agent populations.

items.label: ThinkTree priority nodes (conditionals + JobGivers)
Job + JobDriver Toil state machine
Reservation manager for things and cells
Region / RegionLink graph for reachability
A* on per-cell cost grid; hierarchical/flow-field path sharing
Animal think tree, taming, training
Translation: god edicts/goals as high-priority think nodes

systems.translation: Translated: a chronicle-style narrator (name open — Scribe / Historian / The Chronicle) targeting the player's civilization. Threat points scale with civilization wealth, population and era instead of one colony.

items.label: Storyteller personas (Cassandra/Phoebe/Randy) built from comps: OnOffCycle, RandomMain, ClassicIntro, SingleMTB, Disease
Threat points: wealth and per-pawn curves × difficulty × adaptation × days-passed, clamped 35–10000
IncidentDef/category/target tags, workers (disease applies a hediff; threat/trade/wanderer placeholders), refire and gating rules, incident queue
Quiet-time adaptation factor rising with peaceful days, dropping on downs and deaths
Translation: narrator record (chronicle entries) and persona hook — name still open
Raid squad generator: composition + tactic by points and tech — lands with Factions/Combat
Translation: civilization-scale targeting and era-based scaling

systems.translation: Unchanged mechanics; armies are groups of full agents.

items.label: Verbs: warmup → burst → cooldown state machine; ranged shot reports (accuracy^distance, weapon bands 3/12/25/40, target size, cover) and melee hit/dodge from skill curves
Armor: DamageArmorCategoryDef (Sharp/Blunt/Heat), ArmorUtility deflect/halve rolls, Sharp→Blunt diminish, penetration; wired into DamageWorker_AddInjury
Weapon and projectile content: knife, club, bow, revolver, assault rifle; tool capacities and maneuvers
Cover: CoverInfo/CoverUtility math only — map geometry and line of sight land with Map/AI
Turrets, traps, explosions — lands with Building/Map
Downed / capture / prisoner loop — lands with Factions and AI

systems.translation: Proposed: bills unchanged; guilds and industries act as bill queues at scale.

items.label: Bill queue: recipe + ingredient filter + repeat mode
Ingredient search radius over stockpiles
Skill-weighted quality roll with inspiration
Cooking: meal tiers, food poisoning
Animal husbandry: taming, training, produce cycles, butchering

systems.translation: Translated: a large authored tech tree detailing societal evolution across eras. Data model leaves room for procedural/endless tech later.

items.label: Research project DAG: prerequisites, hidden prerequisites, cycle detection
Research manager: progress, tech-level cost factor (+50% per level above), completion events, Scribe
IResearchUnlockable: what a project unlocks, computed from every def that names it
Translation: EraDef ladder (Sticks & Stones → Exotic) with per-era progress and current/next era
Core XML: research tab, 8 eras, a 30-project seed tree across the first eras
Large authored tech tree of societal evolution — content task on the landed schema
Translation: extension point for procedural tech beyond the authored tree

systems.translation: Proposed: other civilizations are the factions; trade routes replace orbital traders; goodwill becomes diplomacy.

items.label: Silver as abstract barter unit; market value
Price = base × market fluctuation × relation × stock category
Caravans on the world tile graph with time/supply cost
Faction goodwill thresholds → hostile / neutral / ally
Translation: civilization diplomacy and trade routes

systems.translation: Proposed: unchanged mechanics; settlements grow from citizen initiative plus god edicts rather than direct placement of every wall.

items.label: Zones: stockpile, growing, home area
Blueprint → frame → building; materials from stock
Roof support flood-fill and collapse
Power grid graph with brownout policy
Per-room heat diffusion; biome/season modulation
Plant growth from fertility × light × temperature
Translation: citizen-initiated construction under edicts

systems.translation: Proposed: opinions and interactions unchanged; ideoligions become the religions and ideologies of your civilization; DLC systems (genes, psycasts, anomalies) evaluated per era.

items.label: Opinion score from traits, history, interactions, alignment
Periodic interaction rolls (chitchat, insult, social fight)
Romance / rivalry thresholds; marriage and breakup
Memes + precepts feeding thoughts; rituals; roles
Genes, mechanitor bandwidth, psycasts, containment — evaluated per era

systems.translation: Proposed: scenarios become civilization starts (era, biome, rivals); quests become narrator-issued historical moments.

items.label: ScenarioDef: starting conditions and rule modifiers
QuestScriptDef node graphs (trigger → branches → reward/threat)
Delivery via letters with accept/expire timers
Translation: narrator-issued historical moments
